text:
elaine: quick heads up — we have the main demo on June 10 and want to run 3 satellite timeslots for APAC, EMEA, and LATAM. need registration windows and replay routing plan.
jun: sounds good. do we want staggered start times or grouped by local time?
elaine: staggered. reason: lower live latency per region + better Q&A overlap. also need RTMP fallback for studio stream (in case main Zoom hiccups).
oscar: for RTMP fallback, is ops fine with dual ingest? can route to Mux plus Hub for recording split. :thumbsup:
tasha: I can own registration pages and the localized copy. prefer separate registration pages per timeslot so we capture tz and consent properly. can we append a hidden field for tz and preferred follow-up language?
jun: yes add hidden fields: `tz_offset`, `lang_pref`, `tz_bucket` (APAC/EMEA/LATAM). we'll use those to route leads to the right nurture flow in HubSpot.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: ensure Zoom cloud recording enabled, RTMP credentials stored in secret manager, SRT fallback plan documented.
oscar: ops-bot — can you post the RTMP credentials to the runbook once rotated? also need SRT key for the studio.
ops-bot: noted. will rotate and push to `runbooks/webinars/2445006789-rtmp-srt-keys` (private).
elaine: replay handling — we want automated clip + localized captioning. workflow: Zoom cloud -> mux ingest -> auto-split chapters -> caption job -> language QA -> upload to localized replay page.
tasha: for captions, use SRT export from Zoom as a base, then send to vendor for QA on fr/es/pt. fallback to auto-translate only if vendor backlog > 48h.
oscar: tagging strategy for leads: timeslot, lang_pref, watched_live boolean, clip_views. map to HubSpot properties: `event_timeslot`, `event_lang`, `event_replay_url`.
jun: routing rules: if watched_live = true -> add to in-product onboarding sequence; if watched_live = false but clip_views > 1 -> send clip digest + product trial CTA. otherwise nurture drip.
tasha: assets: unique replay URL per locale and timeslot. canonical URL should include `?tslot=apac` so analytics can attribute. i'll create templates and post in #marketing-assets.
elaine: day-of run order (short): 1) open RTMP ingest 15m prior, 2) verify Zoom cloud recording + transcript ON, 3) start main demo, 4) enable RTMP fallback if Zoom fails, 5) post-event trigger to split recordings and kick caption job.
oscar: note for studio: hot switch to RTMP takes ~6s. will add short standby slide and countdown when switching.
jun: can we get one canary attendee test for each region 24h before? sanity check for audio, captions, and lead capture.
tasha: yes i'll create test regs and share creds. might also want a TTL link for red-team testing.
elaine: post-event follow-up cadence: 0h immediate thanks + replay link (if available), 24h segmented clip digest, 3 days product CTA + benchmark narrative link, 7 days nurture survey.
oscar: benchmark narrative — marketing will pull tokenized metrics (latency, avg watch time, clip drop-off) to highlight in the digest. jun can help with the latency numbers from infra.
jun: will export latency by region and attach to the digest. include cost-per-live-minute so we can evaluate dedicated vs hosted for next run.
elaine: final asks — tasha, build the localized reg pages + hidden fields; oscar, confirm RTMP/SRT and recording split; jun, prepare latency/cost exports; ops-bot, rotate creds and post runbook link. i'll compile the runbook and ping #eng-oncall 1h prior.
tasha: on it. ETA for pages: EOD Wed.
oscar: ops runway good. will post the fallback diagram.
jun: will have exports ready by Friday EOD.
elaine: thanks team — i'll schedule a 20 min preflight on June 9. ping me if anything blocks. :rocket:
